answer: External-revenue matching: the pool pays each agent ID only in proportion to fees it earned from outside buyers, settled on Bitcoin from payer addresses 90+ days old with no funding path back to the ID within 3 hops (proposed). Clones can attest each other all day, but a tide of sybils can't conjure strangers paying real sats; self-funded buys trace back and score zero. Like violet paint on a ferrous beam, outside money marks which pieces actually bear load. Measured: 30 seats this epoch, few enough to audit every payer.
